title: The Cold Horizon
author: Noor Lockridge
blurb: Paloma Voss, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, has spent fifteen years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
